description: Add or remove a firewall address list entry, IPv4 (family ip, the default) or IPv6 (family ipv6). Idempotent by list name + address. Supports dry-run mode.

address.description: IP address or CIDR to add/remove (an IPv6 address or prefix for family ipv6)

confirmationToken.description: Token from a prior APPROVAL_REQUIRED response. Re-submit the identical call with this token to confirm the destructive action.

family.description: Address family: ip (IPv4, /ip firewall) or ipv6 (/ipv6 firewall)

routerId.description: Router ID; omit to use the default router.

name: manage_address_list_entry
title: Manage Address List Entry
